subject.title: feat(agents): add multi-pass context compaction with progress tracking

question: Should this PR land partial internal multi-pass compaction scaffolding now, or should it be narrowed to active pruning/summary-boundary behavior until the compaction architecture direction is settled?
rationale: The branch contains concrete fixable defects, but keeping an uncalled multi-pass engine and public settings fields is a product/API direction choice that automation should not decide silently.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Remove the uncalled multi-pass engine and public settings fields for now, keep only the active pruning/summary-boundary improvements once correctness issues are fixed.

options.title: Sponsor full integration
options.body: Maintainers explicitly choose to wire multi-pass compaction into production callers in this PR and require upgrade/session-state proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind architecture issue
options.body: Pause or close this PR until the broader compaction architecture discussion has an approved implementation shape.

recommendation.title: Narrow before merge
recommendation.body: Remove the uncalled multi-pass engine and public settings fields for now, keep only the active pruning/summary-boundary improvements once correctness issues are fixed.
